chunks: When their eyes are turned toward the inmates of Hell, they will say: 'O Lord, do not place us with the people of the wrongdoers.'
ai.seo_question: What do the inhabitants of Hell pray when they see its inmates?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the psychological state of the disbelievers at the moment of their entry into Hell, where they attempt to distinguish themselves from the 'Qawm al-Zalimin' (the people of the Prophet) who are already there. This supplication reflects a lingering hope for mercy or a desire to avoid the specific fate of those who rejected their messengers, yet it often comes too late for salvation. The scene underscores the finality of divine justice while capturing the poignant regret of those who recognized the truth but failed to act upon it.
